description: Create all 8 HTML pages: replace index.html (home dashboard), and create flash.html, quiz.html, write.html, stats.html, favorites.html, custom.html, settings.html. Each page has the same sidebar+header shell, the correct main content section extracted from the original index.html, and loads its own JS. Independent of FEAT-001 only in terms of file content structure, but must be implemented after FEAT-001 so that the JS files already exist when HTML pages reference them.
steps: Define the shared HTML shell that every page reuses. It consists of: 1. : charset, viewport, (page-specific), HanziWriter CDN script (flash.html and write.html only — others omit it), styles.css link 2. <body>: <canvas id='bg-canvas'>, .app-container wrapping: a. <aside class='sidebar' id='sidebar'> with logo + nav. Nav uses actual href URLs: - <a href='index.html' class='menu-item' data-page='home'>🏠 Trang chủ</a> - <a href='flash.html' class='menu-item' data-page='flash'>📇 Flashcard</a> - <a href='quiz.html' class='menu-item' data-page='quiz'>✏️ Trắc nghiệm</a> - <a href='write.html' class='menu-item' data-page='write'>🖌️ Nét chữ</a> - <a href='stats.html' class='menu-item' data-page='stats'>📊 Thống kê</a> - <a href='favorites.html' class='menu-item' data-page='favorites'>❤️ Yêu thích</a> - <a href='custom.html' class='menu-item' data-page='custom'>📝 Tự tạo</a> - <a href='settings.html' class='menu-item' data-page='settings'>⚙️ Cài đặt</a> b. .main-content-layout with: - <header class='app-header'>: hamburger, <h2 class='header-title'> (page-specific title), search wrapper, learnSelectorsWrapper (visible on flash/quiz/write, hidden otherwise), openProfileBtn, hidden themeBtn - Hidden elements needed by app.js compatibility: #favListBtn (display:none), .tabs (display:none) - <main class='app-content'>: page-specific content - <footer class='footer'> 3. Shared modals present on ALL pages: #profileModal, #wqPopupOverlay 4. <div id='toastContainer'></div> 5. Scripts: <script src='data/data.js?v=7'></script> <script src='storage.js?v=7' defer></script> <script src='api-client.js?v=7' defer></script> <script src='profile.js?v=7' defer></script> <script src='js/shared.js' defer></script> <script src='js/[page].js' defer></script>

Replace index.html (Trang chủ / home dashboard):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Trang chủ'
  - HanziWriter CDN: NO (not needed on home)
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: hidden (style='display:none')
  - Main content: copy the entire #section-home section from original index.html (welcomeBanner, dashboardGrid with streak card, homeHskGrid)
  - Page-specific JS: none (home logic is in shared.js)
  - Scripts: data/data.js → storage.js → api-client.js → profile.js → js/shared.js (no page-specific last script)

Create flash.html (Flashcard / Tự học):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Flashcard'
  - HanziWriter CDN: YES (write.html also needs it but flash does not — actually flash.html does NOT need HanziWriter. Only write.html does.)
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: VISIBLE (remove style='display:none' from the wrapper)
  - Main content: copy the entire #flash section from original index.html (statbar, autoplay bar, .fc-wrap, .fc-nav)
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/flash.js

Create quiz.html (Trắc nghiệm):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Trắc nghiệm'
  - HanziWriter CDN: NO
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: VISIBLE
  - Main content: copy the entire #quiz section from original index.html (quizDeckSelection + quizGameSection)
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/quiz.js

Create write.html (Nét chữ):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Nét chữ'
  - HanziWriter CDN: YES — <script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hanzi-writer@3.5/dist/hanzi-writer.min.js'></script> in <head>
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: VISIBLE
  - Main content: copy the entire #write section from original index.html
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/write.js

Create stats.html (Thống kê):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Thống kê'
  - HanziWriter CDN: NO
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: HIDDEN
  - Main content: copy #section-stats from original index.html (statsModal flat section with statsModalBody)
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/stats.js

Create favorites.html (Yêu thích):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Yêu thích'
  - HanziWriter CDN: NO
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: HIDDEN
  - Main content: copy #section-favorites from original index.html (favModal flat section with favModalList)
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/favorites.js

Create custom.html (Tự tạo):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Tự tạo'
  - HanziWriter CDN: NO
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: HIDDEN
  - Main content: copy #section-custom from original index.html (the full glass-card form with search, manual input, wordsList, historyList)
  - Additional modals: importJsonModal, duplicateConfirmModal, studyModeModal (copy from original index.html)
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/custom.js

Create settings.html (Cài đặt):
  - Title: 'WenQing - Cài đặt'
  - HanziWriter CDN: NO
  - learnSelectorsWrapper: HIDDEN
  - Main content: copy #section-settings from original index.html (the glass-card settings panel)
  - Scripts: ... → js/shared.js → js/settings.js
acceptance_criteria: All 8 HTML files exist: index.html, flash.html, quiz.html, write.html, stats.html, favorites.html, custom.html, settings.html
Opening index.html in a browser shows the home dashboard with HSK cards and no JS errors
Opening flash.html shows flashcards, the level/range/shuffle selectors are visible in the header
Opening quiz.html shows the quiz deck selection with HSK grid
Opening write.html shows the HanziWriter panel
Opening stats.html shows the stats section
Opening favorites.html shows the favorites list (empty or populated)
Opening custom.html shows the custom deck form with history
Opening settings.html shows the settings panel
Sidebar nav active state is correctly set based on the current page filename
Sidebar links navigate between pages correctly (no # hrefs remaining in nav items)
learnSelectorsWrapper is visible on flash/quiz/write and hidden on all others
verification: Open each HTML file in browser, check DevTools console for JS errors
Click sidebar links on index.html — confirm navigation to flash.html, quiz.html, etc.
Open flash.html — confirm level/range selectors visible, first card shows, shuffle applied (order varies on reload)
Open quiz.html — confirm HSK grid renders and clicking a level starts the quiz
Open write.html — confirm HanziWriter loads and renders
Open custom.html — add a word and click Học ngay — confirm navigation to flash.html with that word
